high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "aliaabhatt," who has verified status, posted 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features two women sitting on a white couch with a cityscape view in the background. The setting appears to be a high-rise apartment or penthouse, as indicated by the railing and the view of numerous buildings below. The woman on the left has shoulder-length brown hair and is wearing a white blouse with puffed sleeves and white pants. She accessorizes with gold hoop earrings, a bracelet, and rings.
